**Finding: compliant (at fallback) — § 14.3 (p0123)**

- **Governing law:** California — on the playbook's accepted fallback list (Delaware or California), though short of the preferred New York position.
- **Forum:** Binding AAA arbitration, one arbitrator, seated in San Francisco County, California, with judgment enforceable in the San Francisco courts. This is a domestic seat in the same accepted jurisdiction — not the walk-away case of a vendor home jurisdiction outside the list or arbitration seated abroad.
- **Noted, not redlined:** the preference for courts over arbitration. The seat is local and convenient for us, and the fee allocation (non-prevailing party bears AAA fees; each side bears its own presentation costs) is even-handed, so no redline is warranted.
- Section 12 (source code escrow) merely refers disputes back to 14.3, so there is no separate or conflicting forum.
